criteria.text: Copilot view removed: Pro has no Copilot tab, no CopilotView/CopilotEngine code; the right-drawer chat button opens the embedded Personal tabs instead
Discuss/Learn/Plan render in the former Copilot slot of the CaseProperties right drawer behind the same chat icon
The embedded Discuss/Learn/Plan beside the canvas look and feel right at desktop size (layout, no clipped controls)
Feature enabled only for server diagrams: with a local-only .fd file open the chat drawer is disabled/unavailable; with a server diagram it is available
Personal hamburger/slide-out menu (account drawer, diagram list/create) is hidden when embedded in Pro

Embedded tabs operate on Pro's already-open Scene/Diagram: exactly one Scene per open case, no GET of the diagram by the Personal pipeline on open, PDP-accepted items appear in the same Scene the canvas draws

discussion -> extract -> PDP accept -> committed scene data works end-to-end on a Pro server case (real Qt app, sandboxed server): accepted people/events land in the open canvas and persist in the server row
On a real server case with the real coach/extractor: chat beside the canvas, accept a PDP, see it appear on the diagram and survive reopen

Exactly one save path: Pro autosave and the Personal PDP commit both persist through the same DiagramSaver; concurrent-save tests (Pro save vs Personal commit interleavings) pass with no data loss; Personal's JSON save path is gone
Save-before-chat prompt: sending a statement with unsaved Pro edits prompts to save first; saving proceeds; declining does not send
The save-before-chat prompt reads sensibly and is not annoying in normal flow
PersonalAppController decomposed into components under pkdiagram/personal/; when embedded in Pro exactly one Session object exists in-process
A Person with only name='Connie' renders label 'Connie' in the scene (unit test, familydiagram)

Committing an extracted person yields the agreed scene field population: name -> name, last_name -> lastName so last names survive commit; a person with only a last name still gets a visible label (unit tests, btcopilot + familydiagram)
Reopen diagram 1924 in the Pro app: every person has a visible label
One harness: one command + one doc named in the project instructions; no ticket-named sandbox scripts remain; no other launch recipe in the repos

findings.fix: FIXED (implX): file model owns one Diagram instance per id, in-place refresh gated on version, syncDiagramFromServer returns the cached instance. DIAGNOSED (server request log): the writer is Pro's own POST /v1/diagrams/<id>/reserve_ids; the file model keeps TWO Diagram instances per row (cache vs the fresh parse handed to the Scene/allocator, because reserve_ids bumps version without updated_at so the mtime-gated cache swap never fires) — pre-existing on master; makes the D9 blockEnd clamp dead in Pro. Fix (implX): the file model owns one instance per id, in-place refresh gated on version, syncDiagramFromServer returns the cached instance. Tests: tests/models/test_fd336_diagram_identity.py (testX)

grounded_facts: GROUNDED: a scene Person read from a commit-shaped chunk {name:'Connie', last_name:None} renders label 'Connie' on current master (probe 2026-08-25). The ticket's 'single-token name gets no label' premise does NOT reproduce with that shape.

GROUNDED: commit chunks carry last_name (snake) but the scene reads lastName; the snake->camel rename in compat is gated to data versions <= 2.1.11b1, so at the current version the last name is silently dropped on commit and on load.
GROUNDED: a person with name=None and last_name only renders an empty label.

GROUNDED: both writers already send the full pickled DiagramData blob; the Personal path base64-wraps the same pickle onto PUT /personal/diagrams/<id>; Pro PUTs pickle onto /v1/diagrams/<id>. The difference is the applyChange field set (Pro: scene collections + metadata + UI flags; Personal: scene collections + version/name/lastItemId + clusters) and transport.
GROUNDED: server-side commit-pdp writes pdp/lastItemId/people/events/pair_bonds into the row; Pro's applyChange never touches pdp/clusters so they survive a Pro save.
GROUNDED: no local copy of diagram 1924 (dev sqlite empty, docker/postgres down, no pg_restore on host) - C10h stays human.
